take_homes: Rolling out a licence is not the same as people using it. Reports show one number, and the P&L only moves with the second.
Before I fund anything, ask who owns it, who runs it and who answers for it. A plan with unnamed roles is half a plan.
Compare any tool with what people do today. The competitor is the existing spreadsheet or colleague, so ask one person how they do the job now.

monday.move: Ask my controller 20 minutes about how month-end variance commentary gets done today, before showing any tool. Ask who owns the process.
monday.stop_condition: If the controller says the commentary is not a real time sink, I drop it and do not pursue the agent idea.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved any tool for finance data, so I can only ask questions for now, not try anything.

misconception.why: The line about access being a switch and absorption happening in other people's weeks made me see that a licence isn't the whole thing. I still think the licence cost is what I'll be asked about by the board. I have no number for what building the capability costs, so I only half agree.

one_line: Sensible on why rollouts fail and good on naming who owns it, but in the whole module nobody said what any of it costs or pays back.
